saw_lines: Nobody buys windows on impulse. Buyers measure the opening, compare two or three quotes, then wait weeks before they order.
So a buyer who has no reason to pick you on the first screen opens the next supplier’s quote and never returns.
Your 37 Google text ads carry no price, offer or buyer angle. Put a first order offer in the opening line and test it against the current copy.
ads_1: Google text ads leading with a first order offer and made to measure fit
